# Moses and the Burning Bush (Exodus 3:4)

## Emotional Focus
Listening when God calls you to do something important.

## Key KJV
“Here am I.” (Exodus 3:4)

## Gentle Retelling
Moses saw a bush on fire that didn’t burn up. God spoke from the bush and said, “I am sending you.” Moses listened and obeyed, and God helped him every step.

## Coloring Prompt
Moses standing in awe before the glowing burning bush on the mountain.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“When God calls, you can say, ‘Here I am, Lord.’”
